It suits travelers who value privacy, ocean views and a short arrival day, with easy private transfers to explore Playa Hermosa and Playas del Coco nearby.

faq.q: How far is Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica from Guanacaste Airport?
faq.a: The resort is approximately 17 miles from Guanacaste Airport (LIR). Driving time is commonly around 25 to 35 minutes, depending on traffic.

faq.q: Where is Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica located?
faq.a: The resort is located at Punta Cacique on Playa Penca, along Guanacaste's Northern Pacific coast.

faq.q: Can tours pick up at Waldorf Astoria Punta Cacique?
faq.a: Private excursions and transfers can be planned from the resort, with pickup details confirmed according to the selected experience and travel date.
